ORC — a time-on-distance race with no recorded course length scores nobody

ORC Rating Systems 403.2 corrects over the course length, so a race with none cannot be scored under the fleet's option. It is not quietly scored by some other method: ranking it on crossing order would put a scratch race in front of competitors under an ORC fleet's name. Everyone in it is scored as if they had not come to the start, and the standings page names the race and what it is waiting for.

Scoring system: ORC 
The same two boats and the same first race as 16-orc-aphd-tod.
  Mojo (J-80)           APHD 594.7 s/NM — the scratch boat
  Impetuous (Corby 25)  APHD 623.0 s/NM

Race 1, 3.24 NM, start 15:15:00 — scored normally:
  Mojo:      finish 15:50:51  ET = 2151 s  CT = 2151            → 2nd
  Impetuous: finish 15:51:49  ET = 2209 s  CT = 2209 − 91.692   → 1st

Race 2 has a gun and two finishers but no recorded course length, so
there is nothing to correct over. Neither boat is scored: both take the
series-entries penalty of 3 (two entries + 1), and Mojo crossing first
earns nothing for it.
    No distanceNm — the race cannot be scored on time-on-distance.
